puzzle.goal: The last train stands dark at Millbrook. Find the staff key and open the ticket office, switch on the station's supply, take the ticket through the gates, start the escalators and put the traction current on.
steps: Take the staff key off the bench on your left
Open the ticket office's door, on the left past the bench, with the key
Switch on the station supply on the office's far wall
Take the ticket off the counter at the office's window
Put the ticket in the right-hand fare gate and go through
Turn on the escalators at the key switch left of their heads
Down the escalators, throw the traction switch on the wall at the platform's north end
